name: focusroom
description: Tarayıcıda çalışan, çok kullanıcılı 3D birlikte çalışma odası

scripts.dev:client: npm run assets && npm run dev -w @focusroom/client
scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @focusroom/client
scripts.start: npm run assets && npm run build -w @focusroom/client && npm run start -w @focusroom/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @focusroom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @focusroom/server && npm run typecheck -w @focusroom/client
